title: Quietly Pillowy Brazilian Lamb Tagine
description: A delicate and floral Brazilian dish featuring lamb stock and tagine-cooked to perfection, with a light and pillowy texture, macrobiotic-friendly ingredients are used to create a unique culinary experience.
instructions: Heat the lamb stock in a large tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the dried rose petals, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Stir in the chopped parsley and serve hot over rice or with crusty bread.
